body.message:
As per the latest update we have received from our technical team, they have advised that approximately 2–3 working days will be required to complete the necessary maintenance work.

We truly understand the frustration and disappointment you may be feeling at the moment, and we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience this unexpected situation has caused. Unfortunately, as the apartment will not be available during this period, we are unable to proceed with the booking.
